claim_results.reason: Verified the positive-block hypotheses, phase differential equation, interface coordinate changes, half-turn lift, comparison bounds and bisection against each fixed n*pi. The retained endpoint coordinate is a positive angle transformation fixing every n*pi, so it preserves the mathematical mode labels. Personally ran check_spectrum.py normally and with -O: 241 checks passed in each run, including prefixes through 2001 modes. Reproduced the old scanner's incorrect first entry, 3.2671480773046255; the repaired solver returns all four supplied lower brackets before that frequency. Independently rebuilt exact rational Taylor endpoint-sign enclosures for both ideal rational and exact binary64 block lengths. Additional checks used 85-digit physical-state zero counting, interface-zero configurations, constant densities, scaling, reflection and splitting. Invalid and unresolved cases raised explicit errors. At 75-digit precision, wrong guesses recovered requested indices 1–8; scaled-path finite differences retained indices 1–5. No remaining branch, seam or index defect was found within the inspected and executed scope.

Verified DR=-J and the complementary projectors (I-J)/2 and (I+J)/2. Personally executed the reflection tests normally and with -O, both with -W error: all 21 tests passed in each run. Additional tests used the fully imported Recon conversion methods and independently checked actual reconstructed interfaces, nonzero displacement, reflection identities, feasibility and bounded failures. The requested bounded main invocation completed in both SUP and INF, each recording 14 break seeds, 6 preserve seeds and 2 separately labeled ordinary random seeds. Two SUP break seeds requested at step 0.2 were backtracked to 0.05 and their actual geometry passed validation. A separate actual-main run with asymmetric centers rejected and recorded all 10 attempted sector seeds per mode. Labels describe initial seeds, without asserting that subsequent optimization remains in their sector.

Personally ran the actual variation CLI cases '2 4 sup', '2 4 inf' and '2 1 sup' with current numerical defaults: 61 modes, quadrature order 64 and 60 digits; all exited successfully. Checked HighPrecisionTangent, SpectralProbe, checked_roots and finite-difference mode labels, including rejection of ordered lists containing missing indices. Saved root records matched recomputation, retained their indices and carried certified=false. The maximum direct block-tangency residual across these runs was approximately 5.86e-15; this is numerical evidence only. All 122 additional adversarial checks and 263 artifact/provenance checks passed. Actual module origins, including both Recon workers, resolved to the private frozen copies; all 14 original snapshots and copies retained their hashes. No source-project files were modified. Current outputs retain finite-truncation, quadrature, finite-step and fixed-bump limitations and make no whole-history, G1-sign, global-uniqueness or interval-certification claim. Execution evidence, manifests, review scripts and artifacts are saved under /mnt/f/tools/math-audit-round10-20260925/software-reviewer/stateless-8b23fae8-e2gp58jk.

limitations: Approval covers the requested current software and numerical review. Finite executions do not establish correctness for every floating-point input, complete formalization, Hessian definiteness, G1 sign or global uniqueness.

The solver's phase brackets and high-precision refinement are not rigorous interval certificates. Agreement between its two phase implementations is not independent enumeration evidence. Independently rebuilt rational endpoint enclosures establish existence only in the finite brackets checked.

The referenced historical root_bracket_certificates.json and external literature were not supplied as packet inputs and were not inspected. Historical results and unexecuted Green/Jacobian routines were not revalidated; the optional _gapn2_jacobian_spectral dependency was not supplied.

Recon initially encountered audit-environment Unix-socket failures from a long temporary path and the mounted Windows filesystem. The unchanged CLI subsequently completed using a private Linux TMPDIR. Initial failures and successful executions are preserved in the logs.
